Inputs.Description: Connect to an If's Branches pin.

Options.Label: When
Options.Description: Condition; leave empty on the last branch for an else. A LowTalk expression, e.g. $met, not $player.done, has("Food_Bread", 2), chance(0.5).

Outputs.Label: Body
Outputs.Description: The statements that run here, in link order: Say, Choice, Set, Jump and so on.
